biggest_catch: You earn the $50 cash award only if the new member's qualifying account stays open at least 6 months — rewards are dispensed after six months of account opening, and AlaTrust employees are ineligible.
catches: New member's account must remain open at least 6 months; rewards dispensed after six months of account opening
Qualifying accounts: checking with direct deposit, or auto/home/personal/VISA loan of at least $10,000
New member must be at least 18 years old and eligible for membership (lives/works/worships/attends school in the 12 counties served, or family of a member)
AlaTrust employees are not eligible for this promotion
Referral is made via the paper referral coupon that the new member submits when opening the account
No annual referral cap stated in the referral coupon terms
The coupon document's currentness is not dated; terms confirmed from the live official alatrustcu.com document 2026-09-23

steps: Be an existing AlaTrust Credit Union member
Fill out the referral coupon and give it to your friend, family member, or coworker
The new member submits the completed coupon when opening a qualifying account (checking with direct deposit or $10k+ loan)
The account must remain open at least 6 months
You receive the $50 cash award after six months of account opening
timing: Filling out and handing off the coupon takes ~10 minutes active; the $50 award is dispensed after six months of account opening (not instant).
